data.spec: Add read-only worker endpoints and workspace serialization for listing a project's agent runs and fetching one raw transcript from the durable transcript ref, with strict project/run id validation, bounded responses, plain-text content handling, and explicit not-found/error behavior. Extend the project pane with an audit-oriented transcript selector/viewer that shows role, task, outcome, and time metadata and loads raw content on demand without confusing it with the existing event-derived Transcript timeline; include worker endpoint/serializer tests and UI tests for loading, empty, failure, and oversized/truncated states.
data.title: Expose raw transcripts in the audit UI
